headline: Approved $2,356,182.48 in bond payments and recommended PRIME Consulting for third party testing at the Dual Language school.
summary: Project updates covered high school closeout, track and field work, and Dual Language project budgets. The group recommended a testing services contract and approved bond payments.
decisions: Approved the September 2, 2026 meeting minutes; all in favor, with Rory Marty abstaining.
Recommended PRIME Consulting Inc. for the Third Party Testing Services contract for the Dual Language School, Bid 2026-0009, to the Central Falls Purchasing Board; all in favor.
Approved payment of Bond Series 2025 Requisition #5 totaling $2,356,182.48; all in favor.

decision_evidence.quote: A. Lynch made a motion to approve the minutes as presented, seconded by M. Jerzyk ... All in favor

M. Jerzyk made a motion to recommend the award of the City of Central Falls, RFP 2026-0009-Third Party Testing Services for the Dual Language School Bid to PRIME Consulting Inc. to the Central Falls Purchasing Board. S. Freidman seconded the motion ... All In Favor
M. Jerzyk made a motion to approve the School Bond Series 2025 #5 for $ 2,356,182.48. A. Lynch seconded the motion. No Discussion All In Favor
